summary: Retest of iteration-98 fixes (customer-data protection + onboarding). Backend: new tests/test_privacy_fixes_iter99.py (29 tests) + regression test_privacy_onboarding.py + test_role_access_limited.py => 104/108 pass. All requested fixes verified: on every requested list the phone/customer_phone/to keys are masked for the manager and stay full for the admin; GET /api/customers/{id} shows the full number and is logged; staff phones (/api/users, /api/team) stay full; PATCH order/customer with a masked phone keeps the original; rider /api/notifications 403 and /api/me/notifications 200; staff email lockout gives 429 on the 9th try (8 x 401 first); a 12-month template gives expires_at exactly +1 year; manager regen-access-code is logged. 4 remaining leaks/bypasses were found (see below). Frontend: all 5 UI fixes verified, and both regression flows (TEST_UI sales sign flow, rider1 Appeler/Je suis arrivé) pass end to end.

critical.issue: `phone` is masked but `phone_digits` (e.g. 2250700000011) and the wa.me/<full number> links in the same rows are not. The full customer number is still readable. PHONE_KEYS in role_access.py does not include phone_digits, and wa links are inside URL strings.
Returns customer_phone in full (+2250700000002). The /api/out-of-catalog prefix is missing from PHONE_MASKED.

The free-text `msg` of the 'Alerte retour en stock' (waitlist) alert contains the full phone, e.g. 'Mules Raphia Naturel · taille 39 · +225 05 48 11 22 02'. The key-based masking does not cover message text.

minor.issue: Lockout is keyed on the first X-Forwarded-For value, which the client controls. After 8 bad PINs from XFF=10.250.x.x the next try gets 429, but the same request with a different XFF header gets 401 again. Brute-forcing a 4-digit PIN is therefore unlimited. Fix: use the right-most (proxy-added) XFF entry, or add a global staff-pin cap like rider-login-pin has (40 per 15 min).
Lockout is per email only, so anyone can lock the owner/admin out for 15 minutes with 8 bad tries. This is an accepted trade-off; consider adding an IP component or a CAPTCHA.
Builds AI chat text with full customer phones (c.get('phone')). This bypasses the masking if a manager can use the AI assistant. Use mask_phone for non-admin users.

issues: The table (display:block, overflow-x:auto) scrolls horizontally as intended. When scrolled, the action icons column draws past the end of the striped row background (row width 790 px vs content 832 px). Cosmetic only.

design_issues.screen: Login for an onboarding-pending punch-required user
issues: Shows the toast 'pointez votre arrivée pour continuer' while the user is actually on the 'Documents à signer' gate. Message order is confusing; minor.

action_items: Mask or strip `phone_digits` and the wa.me links in /api/whatsapp-outbox for non-admin users (e.g. serve the link via a server-side redirect endpoint, or add phone_digits to PHONE_KEYS and rewrite wa links)
Mask phones inside notification msg text (waitlist 'retour en stock' alert), or leave the phone out of that text
staff login-pin throttle: do not trust a client-supplied X-Forwarded-For first hop; add a global cap
Mask phones in the AI tool output (_ai_tool_inactive_customers) for non-admin users
critical_code_review_comments: role_access._mask_phones only masks values whose key is in PHONE_KEYS and that match PHONE_RE. Phones embedded in free text or URLs (msg, wa_link, message bodies) slip through. Consider a text-level regex pass for non-admin users on PHONE_MASKED paths.

PHONE_MASKED is an allow-list of prefixes, so any new customer-facing endpoint leaks by default. Consider deny-by-default (mask on every GET for non-admin users, except staff endpoints /api/users, /api/team, /api/customers/{id}).
OnboardingGate: the fix is correct. When the retry also fails, the error is shown again; that works.
